caption: The video captures a static close-up of a Halloween-themed table setting, with a glass of bright green liquid centered among a blue glass orb on a gold stand, a silver candlestick, flowers, a lit votive candle, and a purple napkin on spiderweb-draped black fabric. White vapor continuously billows and swirls from the rim of the drink, rising upward and curling around the glass while the surrounding objects remain fixed. The vapor shifts direction dynamically, sometimes drifting left toward the candle and flowers and later spreading right toward the blue orb. Its density fluctuates, at times obscuring the upper portion of the glass and the background floral arrangement. Thin streams also settle across the black table surface in the foreground and mid-ground.
